answers.core: This is core functionality already present in the engine that just needs to be exposed somewhere else, as far as I can tell.
answers.workaround: You can approximate apply_force by using apply_impulce (force * delta), but some of the other missing properties are much harder to work around. The missing signals, especially, do not have a clean workaround as far as I can tell.

title: Add methods, properties and signals that are present in RigidBody3D to PhysicalBone3D
